documentation.accessibilityText:
CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Expose declared range or group semantics with keyboard alternatives for every pointer/touch gesture.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown

FOCUS

Focusable Operable Handle, Multi Handle Order, Visible Focus

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 2.5.1, 2.5.7, 2.5.8, 4.1.2

These requirements come from the canonical Splitter catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.

documentation.usageCode:
<script lang="ts">
  import { SplitterRoot, SplitterPanel, SplitterResizeTrigger, SplitterResizeHandle } from '@uifn/components-svelte/splitter'
  import '@uifn/components/styles.css'
</script>

<SplitterRoot defaultSizes={[40,60]} aria-label="Splitter example">
  <SplitterPanel value={0}>Navigation</SplitterPanel>
  <SplitterPanel value={1}>Editor</SplitterPanel>
  <SplitterResizeTrigger value={0}>Resize panels</SplitterResizeTrigger>
  <SplitterResizeHandle value={0} />
</SplitterRoot>
